title: Choose the homepage composition
question: The visual world is fixed. Which structure should carry forward into the real responsive implementation?

options.label: Core Cutaway
options.lineage: transformer section · curriculum rail · UI fragments
options.body: A direct split viewport pairs the value proposition with one transformer core cutaway and a vertical eight-track depth scale. It proves the world can govern every route family immediately. Carry forward the readable split, layered core, and track rail; do not literalize the mockup's dashboard fragments, invented sign-in, or tiny labels.

options.label: Diagonal Descent
options.lineage: one bathymetric spine · evidence branches · continuous depth
options.body: The homepage becomes one diagonal descent from surface intuition to systems, with the real eight tracks occupying successive depth treads and evidence branching perpendicular to the main path. It is the clearest composition for course structure and the easiest to translate into a deliberate vertical mobile survey. Carry forward the diagonal reading order, evidence branches, and continuous field; do not literalize generated track names, lesson counts, or decorative nautical icons.

options.label: Inhabited Depth Type
options.lineage: architectural headline · embedded layers · signal path
options.body: The words DEEP DIVE become the cutaway, with curriculum strata and a transformer signal path living inside the letterforms. It is the most memorable first viewport, but the typography must not outrank bilingual clarity or long-form wayfinding. Carry forward the idea of content inhabiting a section cut; do not rasterize lettering or copy the mockup's invented taxonomy.
